**Tax‑credit categories that were issued more than $100 million in at least one year between 2000 and 2004 (per the Missouri Accountability Portal)**

| Category | Years in which it exceeded $100 million |
|----------|----------------------------------------|
| **Housing** | 2000 ($130 M), 2002 ($136 M), 2003 ($121 M), 2004 ($174 M) |
| **Redevelopment** | 2002 ($181 M), 2003 ($227 M), 2004 ($162 M) |
| **Business Recruitment** | 2000 ($101 M) |

These totals are taken from the portal’s “Tax Credit Category” pages that list the issued amounts for each category by year.

**Sources**

* 2000: Business Recruitment ($101,460,962.91) & Housing ($130,547,904.17) – *Missouri MAP | Tax Credit Category* (year 2000)【page note: https://mapyourtaxes.mo.gov/map/taxcredits/Categories/Default.aspx?year=2000】  
* 2002: Housing ($136,069,573.15) & Redevelopment ($181,037,125.84) – *Missouri MAP | Tax Credit Category* (year 2002)【page note: https://mapyourtaxes.mo.gov/map/taxcredits/Categories/Default.aspx?year=2002】  
* 2003: Housing ($121,262,201.93) & Redevelopment ($227,160,561.02) – *Missouri MAP | Tax Credit Category* (year 2003)【page note: https://mapyourtaxes.mo.gov/map/taxcredits/Categories/Default.aspx?year=2003】  
* 2004: Housing ($174,233,061.24) & Redevelopment ($162,102,812.82) – *Missouri MAP | Tax Credit Category* (year 2004)【page note: https://mapyourtaxes.mo.gov/map/taxcredits/Categories/Default.aspx?year=2004】  

Thus, the categories that reached the $100 million threshold at least once in that period are **Housing**, **Redevelopment**, and **Business Recruitment**.
